gates.name: color_budget
gates.summary: 43 distinct simultaneous colours (42 non-transparent CRAM entries + backdrop), limit 58

detail.note: Structural invariant: 60 non-transparent slots + 1 backdrop means this count can never exceed 61. Failing here means the VLAB dump is malformed, not that art overspent the budget.
Structural invariant on this path: PAL_getColors() masks every entry with VDPPALETTE_COLORMASK (0x0EEE) as it reads CRAM, so an illegal value cannot reach the dump. Kept as a corruption canary only.

gates.name: screenshot_color_count
gates.summary: 168 distinct colours in the 640x480 screenshot, limit 174

detail.note: SOFT: cannot bound a scene that uses raster palette changes. One CRAM entry driven through N raster stops yields up to N*3 screen colours. Use color_budget (CRAM occupancy) as the real constraint. BlastEm scales the framebuffer with nearest-neighbour, so screenshot colours map 1:1 onto on-screen colours. Raise the limit to 183 if the project uses shadow/highlight.

gates.name: sprites_per_scanline
gates.summary: peak 1 sprites on a sampled scanline, limit 20

detail.note: SAMPLED, not exhaustive: the probe watches 4 scanlines per frame and rotates them, so a one-frame spike on an unwatched line is invisible. A pass is weak evidence; a fail is strong.

gates.name: plane_size_locked
gates.summary: plane is 64x32 tiles (4096 bytes per nametable); doc/VRAMMAP.md section 2 locks 64x32

gates.name: vram_tables_in_range
gates.summary: 0 VDP tables extend past the 64KB VRAM window

detail.note: The window plane legitimately shares its address with BG_A in some SGDK configurations; investigate a bg_a~window hit before treating it as a bug.

gates.name: vram_tile_budget
gates.summary: declared tile usage 32128 bytes vs 49152 bytes available below the lowest VDP table (0xC000)

detail.note: Checks the DECLARATION in the doc, not the ROM. It cannot detect tiles the code uploads without declaring them.

gates.name: krb1_present
gates.summary: no KRB1 telemetry block in save.sram; the KRB1-based gates below cannot run. Only scenes that call PROBE_STAGE_exportToSram emit it.

gates.name: zero_over_budget_frames
gates.summary: 0 frames exceeded the CPU budget in the sampled window

gates.name: cpu_load_p99
gates.summary: CPU load p99 = 21% over 32 samples, limit 100%

detail.note: 32 consecutive frames is roughly half a second. This is a snapshot, not sustained-performance evidence.

gates.name: section_attribution
gates.summary: peak raster lines per subsystem: input=2, scene=2, audio=2, sprite=188, vblank_idle=244

detail.note: Resolution is one scanline (~0.4% of a frame). 'vblank_idle' is headroom, not work. Interrupts firing inside a section are charged to that section.

claim_limit: These gates check ONE captured window of ONE scene. They prove nothing about scenes, inputs or durations that were not captured. Several gates are structural invariants that cannot fail; see tools/harness/README.md.
